utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What exactly needs fixing on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Mostly the roads and drainage by the east bend, from what I heard. They’re checking the cracked pavement and a loose sign too.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So who’s handling those repairs, and when are they starting?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Noah. I’ve got a few tools I can lend for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, great, thanks Gus. I might need a wrench if you’ve got one.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, I’ve got a wrench you can borrow for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I heard the repair drive’s picking up again this week, and folks are dropping supplies by the hall after lunch.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I hope they’ve got a clear drop-off spot this time. I can’t haul much, so I’m trying to plan before I go.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yeah, they’re setting it by the hall entrance this time, so you shouldn’t have to go far.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can help with that, Opal. Tell me what still needs fixing and I’ll take a look.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ve got the porch light and the gate latch still needing work.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’ll take a look at both. If you can point me to the porch light first, I can start there.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, I’m spreading the word about the repair drive now - come by if you want to help out or just drop off supplies.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Quinn. I might come by later and drop off what I can.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, I’ll keep an eye out for you. Thanks for chipping in.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Leo — I’m keeping the repair drive organized and I’ll make sure everyone knows where they can help.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with the heavy stuff. Tell me what needs fixing first.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Start with the biggest issues first: the front steps and the loose railing need attention before we tackle the smaller fixes.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you go over the repair drive details once more? I want to make sure I have the right items before I help.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sure, the drive is for repair items like basic tools, tape, screws, and replacement bulbs. I’ll take another pass if you want the full list.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, please give me the full list so I can check I’ve got everything right.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate, but I need the repair drive details first so I can fit it around pickup and school hours.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sure, send me the date and time window, and I’ll see if I can work it around school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard there was a repair drive, but I'm only getting bits and pieces. What’s the latest?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It’s moving along, though I’ve only heard the basics so far. I can check what’s confirmed and fill you in if you want.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it. If you confirm the basics, I can help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can help with that.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You can handle the repair drive, right?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, I can handle the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard the repair drive is moving along. Tell me what you need from me.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing — I could use a hand sorting materials and maybe a ride to the hardware store if you’re free.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can do that, especially the sorting. I’ll let you know about the ride once I check my schedule.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I can help with that repair drive. Just tell me what needs fixing and I’ll repeat the plan around.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got the supplies covered; just tell me what parts you need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, then I’ll keep repeating the plan and let folks know what parts are needed.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the repair drive’s picking up, so I’m going to swing by and see what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’ll be around if you need an extra hand.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, I may take you up on that if I find anything tricky.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing, Vik — I might need a quick reminder on which bit of the repair drive you mean, but I’m in.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Right, the repair drive for the fence gate by Maple Street. I’ll swing by after supper and bring a screwdriver.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Perfect, I’ll be there after supper. I’ll bring a hand too, just in case the gate gives us a fight.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, the repair drive. I might've missed the latest update, but I can catch up.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ll send you the latest note in a minute.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — send it over when you can.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Eli — I can bring over a ladder and my drill if that helps. Just tell me where you need me.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That should do it. Bring the ladder to the back porch, and we’ll start with the loose gutter first.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Perfect, I’ll bring the ladder around to the back porch now.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can help with that—what still needs fixing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Mostly the loose floorboards and that back gate latch. I can send more people over if you think of anything else.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I heard the repair drive’s going on, and I’m happy to help connect folks who can pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can point people to the folks who need parts or tools, and keep track of who’s available.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect, I can help match people to the right needs and make sure no one is left waiting.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’ve got the repair drive list ready, Cleo. Tell me which house you want to start with and I’ll line up the volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Start with the Miller house. I know they’ve been waiting on a few repairs, and I can check my supply list for what they’ll need.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, I’ll line up the volunteers for the Miller house and keep an eye out for what your supply list needs.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard there’s a repair drive, but I’m only getting bits and pieces. What’s the latest?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard they’re taking drop-offs at the community hall all afternoon, and they still need tools if anyone has spares.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I can help, but I only caught the repair drive part. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I need someone to take the repair drive items and tell me which school-time drop-offs or pickups they can cover.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it - send me the items and I’ll sort which school drop-offs or pickups I can cover.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can help with that, Kira. Tell me what needs fixing and I’ll pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You mean the repair drive today, right? What exactly needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, the repair drive today. I’m ready to help with whatever needs fixing.
